rules: Verify the destination and avoid duplicate entries before submitting.
Do not certify data redistribution rights, native-client compatibility or support SLAs without separate evidence.
Do not treat source-router and Research Desk tools as the same product.
Use each API's actual CORS and access scope; do not infer a commercial license from a free public endpoint.

products.name: LiquiLens Public Research API
products.pricing_scope: Free public research; private pilots are separately scoped.
products.description: Read-only bank and lender research from public disclosures. Retrieve covered-institution evidence with source links, reporting dates, historical status and missingness. Public research access requires no API key; results support human review and are not credit ratings or investment recommendations.

products.name: Seiche Public Research API
products.pricing_scope: Free public research option; any additional authorized tools remain separate.
products.description: Source-cited research for funding markets, benchmarks, FX and capital-market context. Responses retain observation dates, units, coverage limits and restricted or unavailable states. Public research access requires no API key. Source cadence varies; a successful response is not a freshness guarantee.

products.name: Undertow Market Liquidity API
products.pricing_scope: Free public summary; full-fidelity machine-payable and subscriber tools have separate requirements.
products.description: Read-only market-liquidity research with dated venue evidence and size-specific exit-cost estimates. Public summary access is free; authorization and payment requirements for other surfaces remain explicit. Estimates preserve methodology and coverage limits and are not executable quotes.

products.name: Financial Evidence Research API
products.pricing_scope: Free public research reads; no API key required.
products.description: A read-only REST API for seven financial-research dataset views, including bank disclosures, funding benchmarks and history, liquidity evidence and source health. Results keep source links, dates, native units, hashes and unavailable values. Source-specific rights and partial coverage apply; some views report availability only.

products.name: Financial Evidence Research Desk
products.pricing_scope: Free public research reads; no API key required.
products.description: Eight read-only MCP tools for paginated financial research and source-health checks across seven dataset views. Sources, dates, units and unavailable values remain attached. Includes a browser desk and REST/OpenAPI examples. This hosted research service is distinct from the three-tool Financial Evidence source router.

products.name: Financial Evidence
products.pricing_scope: Free public source routing; no API key required.
products.description: A bounded read-only source router for financial evidence from LiquiLens, Seiche, Undertow and Palimpsest. It preserves product boundaries, source status and provenance and does not combine distinct evidence into a trading score. This is the three-tool source router, separate from the eight-tool Research Desk.
